Short Information : Uttar Pradesh Government (UP Govt) Anganwadi has recently published the official notification for the recruitment of UP Anganwadi posts on the official website of UP Anganwadi. The online application process for UP Anganwadi Bharti Recruitment 2026 started in November 2025, and candidates can apply till September 2026 (district-wise). Candidates must check the complete details for UP Anganwadi Bharti Recruitment 2026, which are given below.

UP Anganwadi Bharti Vacancy 2026 : Qualification

  • Candidates who have passed their Class 12th (10+2 Intermediate) Exam from any recognize University in India will be eligible for this post.
  • Only for Female Candidates.
  • Candidate must be a resident of the respective Village / Ward / Nyaya Panchayat from where she is applying.
  • All candidates must read the official information completely before applying.

UP Anganwadi Bharti Online Form 2026 : How To Apply

  • Candidates can apply through link http://upanganwadibharti.in/ or provided below in link section or they can also apply through official site of the UP Aganwadi before Last Date.
